description: A tuple of two tuples of different lengths and a tuple of one number fail to unify
notes: The spec unifies tuple types only when they have the same length. hashicorp/hcl unifies tuples of different lengths to a list when their elements unify (unifyTupleTypesToList in cty/convert/unify.go), but the tuples [1, 2] and [3] and the number 4 have no common type either, so both fail. Ranking those element types compares the two inner tuples, whose lengths differ (compareTypes in cty/convert/compare_types.go).
reference_error: The 'true' tuple has length 2, but the 'false' tuple has length 1
